name: costas_array_n13__v2_h
prompt:
Find a Costas array of order 13: place 13 marks on an 13x13 grid, one per row and one per column, such that all 13*(12)/2 displacement vectors (dr, dc) between pairs of marks (with dc > 0) are pairwise distinct.

Return x as a list of 13 integers in 0..12, where x[c] is the row of the mark in column c (permutation), or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such array exists.

Partial assignment (fixed values that must be respected):
- x[4]=3, x[9]=1
Return a complete solution consistent with these fixed assignments.
